text: Bar stock 40 mm diameter cut to 120 mm length with 1 mm allowance per side.
Material cut with 2 mm allowance.
12 blanks sawn from 6 m bar, average cut time 45 s per piece.
Billet cut to 85 mm length and deburred with file on both ends.
Round bar 50 mm cut to 200 mm with face flatness within 0.2 mm.
Aluminum plate 300 x 150 mm sheared into 4 pieces of 75 x 150 mm.
Cutting blade fed at 0.05 mm per tooth with no vibration observed.
20 pcs cut to 60 mm length, batch completed in 35 minutes.
Stainless bar 25 mm cut with coolant flow set to 8 l/min.
Square tube 40 x 40 mm cut to 350 mm with ends squared to 90 degrees.
Steel bars 30 mm cut to 150 mm with length tolerance of +/-0.3 mm.
Brass rod 16 mm cut into 45 mm slugs, labeled and stacked.
Cut sequence completed with 3 mm stock margin left on each blank.
3 pcs rejected: cut length 152 mm instead of 150 mm, recut from remaining stock.
Blank edge chipped 1.5 mm deep, scrapped and replaced with a new piece.
Cut face out of squareness by 0.4 degrees on 5 pcs, vise reset and parts recut.
Bar cut 4 mm short of drawing length on 2 pcs, marked for scrap.
Band saw blade broke after 180 cuts and was replaced with a new 27 tpi blade.
Saw coolant pump stopped for 15 minutes and restarted after filter cleaning.
Hydraulic feed pressure dropped to 40 bar, reducing cut rate by 30 percent.
Circular saw guard sensor faulted twice, reset and cutting resumed.
Bar stock 42 mm showed 0.8 mm ovality, so 6 pcs were set aside.
Aluminum billet had an 8 mm long internal crack at the cut end, so 2 pcs were scrapped.
Steel bar bent 3 mm over 1 m length and was straightened before cutting.
Incoming 20 mm rods had 0.3 mm deep scale, so cuts were taken from the clean section.
Shaft Ø40 h9 turned to Ø38.5 mm in two passes with Ra 1.6 finish achieved.
Rough turned OD to 42 mm, leaving 1.5 mm stock for the finishing pass.
Face cut at 0.8 mm depth per pass, total length held at 120 mm.
Center drilled Ø3.15 mm on both ends before turning between centers.
Chamfer 1 x 45° applied to both ends of the bushing.
Groove 4 mm wide turned to 2.5 mm depth at 1200 rpm.
Spindle set to 850 rpm with 0.2 mm/rev feed for the finish pass.
Bore Ø20 H7 finished to 20.02 mm, within tolerance.
Batch of 48 parts turned at 60 pcs per hour without interruption.
Thread M16x1.5 cut in 6 passes, go gauge fits first time.
150 mm long shaft supported by tailstock, runout held at 0.02 mm.
Coolant flow set to 8 L/min during roughing.
R2 radius turned on shoulder with form tool and checked with template.
2 pcs rejected: journal Ø30 measured 29.92 mm, below tolerance, scrapped.
Shoulder turned 0.4 mm short at 25 mm length, reworked after facing back.
Taper measured 0.06 mm over 100 mm, exceeding the 0.02 mm limit, part reworked.
Sealing diameter came out at Ra 3.2 instead of Ra 1.6, repolished to spec.
CNMG insert chipped after 35 min of cutting, replaced with a new insert.
Chuck jaws slipped at 1200 rpm, so clamping pressure was raised to 4.5 bar.
Spindle vibration at 1800 rpm, so speed was reduced to 1400 rpm to stop chatter.
Turret indexing failed twice, tool 3 recalibrated with a 0.01 mm offset correction.
Bar stock Ø52 mm showed a hard spot at 10 mm depth, so feed was reduced to 0.12 mm/rev.
Bar bent 0.5 mm over its 300 mm length, straightened before turning.
Blank Ø45 mm arrived 0.8 mm oversize, so an extra roughing pass was added.
Cast blank porosity found at 3 mm depth, 2 pcs scrapped and remaining batch checked.
Slot 12 mm wide milled to 24 mm depth on bracket, within tolerance.
Pocket roughed with 10 mm end mill at 2400 rpm, leaving 0.2 mm finish allowance.
Top face milled on 6061 plate, surface roughness measured at Ra 1.6.
Flange contour finished with 0.05 mm stock removed in the final pass.
Four 8 mm through holes milled on a 60 mm bolt circle diameter.
Side walls of block milled to 40.00 mm width and checked with micrometer.
Shoulder milled with 16 mm face mill at 1800 rpm and feed of 600 mm/min.
Keyway milled 5 mm wide and 3 mm deep in shaft hub.
1 x 45 degree chamfer milled on all top edges of housing.
Parallel faces milled to 25.4 mm thickness with parallelism within 0.02 mm.
R5 radius milled in inside corners of cavity using 10 mm ball nose cutter.
Part indexed 90 degrees on rotary table for four-side milling, 2 setups completed.
Slot depth of 8.00 mm verified with depth gauge, no re-machining needed.
2 pcs rejected: slot width 12.08 mm against 12.00 mm tolerance, reworked and accepted.
Pocket measured 30.12 mm instead of 30.00 mm, recut to size and passed inspection.
Scratch 0.3 mm deep found on flange face, polished out to Ra 0.8.
Wall thickness measured 3.2 mm instead of 3.5 mm on housing, marked for QC review.
Spindle vibration rose to 4.5 mm/s during roughing, so speed was reduced from 2400 to 1800 rpm.
6 mm end mill broke after 45 minutes, replaced and tool offset reset.
Coolant nozzle clogged, so machining stopped for 12 minutes to clear it before the finishing pass.
Z-axis backlash of 0.02 mm compensated after machine warm-up check.
Casting porosity 1.5 mm deep found under face, milled 2 mm deeper and recut.
Billet hardness measured 42 HRC against 35 HRC spec, so feed was reduced to 150 mm/min.
Aluminum bar bowed 0.8 mm over 300 mm length, flattened before milling.
Soft 6082 chips welded to the cutting edge, causing 2 pcs to be scrapped.
Shaft polished to Ra 0.8 after 3 passes with 1200 grit paper.
Flange faces polished to Ra 0.4 in 6 minutes per part.
Buffing wheel run at 1800 rpm, 40 pcs finished in one batch.
Bore surface polished with 400 grit flap wheel to Ra 1.6.
Chamfers on 20 pcs polished by hand with 320 grit strip.
Stainless housing brought to mirror finish with 0.02 mm stock removed.
Polishing compound reapplied every 15 parts as per procedure.
Gear tooth flanks polished and surface roughness measured at Ra 0.6.
Batch of 30 bushings polished in 45 minutes without rework.
Edge radius R0.5 blended on 12 pcs with a Scotch-Brite pad.
Aluminium plates polished to satin finish with 0.01 mm removed per side.
Sealing groove polished to Ra 0.8 with 600 grit cord.
Polishing wheel trued with 2 mm cut off the face before the run.
2 pcs rejected: scratch 0.05 mm deep on sealing face, repolished and accepted.
Shaft diameter reduced to 24.92 mm after overpolishing, one part scrapped.
Orange peel visible on 3 pcs, reworked with 800 grit to Ra 0.4.
Corner radius came out R1.2 instead of R0.8 on 5 pcs, reset for rework.
Polishing spindle vibrated at 1500 rpm, bearing replaced after a 20 minute stop.
Buffing wheel glazed after 25 parts, dressed with a 2 mm cut before continuing.
Coolant nozzle clogged, polishing paused for 10 minutes until cleared.
Belt tracking drifted 3 mm off center, adjusted and recalibrated.
Casting porosity with 0.5 mm pits showed up on 4 pcs after polishing, sent to scrap.
Hardness of 58 HRC made abrasive wear about 40% faster than expected.
Stock arrived with a 0.3 mm rust film, so an extra 0.1 mm was removed before polishing.
Bar stock oversize by 0.08 mm required additional polishing time on every part.
Parts washed in ultrasonic bath at 45 °C for 10 minutes.
Coolant residue removed from 24 pcs with alkaline wash and rinsed in deionized water.
Batch of 40 pcs dried with compressed air at 0.4 MPa.
Chips flushed from blind holes with 6 bar jet rinse.
Two-stage rinse completed, final rinse conductivity below 20 uS/cm.
Oil film removed from 18 housings in 5 % detergent bath for 8 minutes.
Washing basket loaded with 12 parts per cycle, cycle time 15 minutes.
Parts dried in oven at 80 °C for 20 minutes and checked for water spots.
Threaded holes M12 cleaned with brush and blown out with air.
Rust prevention oil applied to 30 pcs after washing.
Wash tank temperature held at 55 °C throughout the 60-minute batch.
Deburring swarf removed from 4 mm wide slots using pressure spray.
Parts rinsed for 3 minutes and transferred to packing within 30 minutes.
3 pcs rejected: residual chips in 2 mm bore, recleaned and accepted.
Water spots found on 5 pcs of aluminum flange, re-dried and passed inspection.
Shaft diameter 25 mm scratched by basket contact, 2 pcs scrapped.
Burn marks on 4 pcs from excessive oven temperature, reworked by polishing 0.1 mm off the surface.
Ultrasonic generator fault at 40 kHz stopped washing for 25 minutes, restarted after reset.
Dryer blower motor overheated at 90 °C, cooled down and resumed after 15 minutes.
Wash tank filter clogged, pressure dropped from 6 bar to 3 bar, so the filter was cleaned.
Conveyor basket jammed at station 3, freed and resumed after a 10 minute stop.
Casting porosity on 6 pcs trapped coolant, requiring an extra 10 minute rinse.
Aluminum parts arrived with heavy machining oil, so the pre-wash cycle was extended to 25 minutes.
Brass fittings showed green oxidation spots, cleaned with 2 % citric acid solution.
Steel blanks delivered with rust film on 15 pcs, removed by wire brushing and washing.
Bore diameter 25.00 mm checked with bore gauge, within H7 tolerance.
First article inspected: all 14 dimensions within drawing tolerance.
Thread M12x1.75 verified with go/no-go gauge, passed.
Surface roughness Ra 1.6 µm measured on 5 pcs, all accepted.
Overall length 85.02 mm measured with micrometer, within ±0.05 mm.
Batch of 40 pcs sampled per AQL 1.0, zero rejects.
Flatness of mounting face 0.02 mm verified on surface plate.
Hole positions checked on CMM, maximum deviation 0.03 mm.
Chamfers 0.5 x 45° inspected with template, all conforming.
Parts marked with batch number and passed to packing.
Concentricity of OD to ID 0.01 mm confirmed on dial indicator.
Height gauge measurement of step 12.00 mm within 0.02 mm.
Visual inspection of 20 pcs completed, no scratches found.
3 pcs rejected: bore 16.08 mm oversize, reworked and accepted.
Slot width 8.15 mm exceeds 8.00 +0.05 mm tolerance on 2 pcs, scrapped.
Thread M8 on 4 pcs has flank damage, rejected for rework.
Burr 0.2 mm found on edge of 5 pcs, rechecked after deburring.
CMM probe calibration drifted by 0.004 mm, recalibrated before measuring further parts.
Bore gauge dial stuck at 0.01 mm, replaced and re-verified.
Surface plate height gauge stylus worn, measurements delayed by 30 minutes.
Optical comparator lamp failed, switched to backup unit after 15 minutes.
Incoming bar hardness 28 HRC instead of 32 HRC, 6 pcs held for review.
Casting porosity 2 mm found on 3 pcs, rejected with supplier notice.
Aluminium bar diameter 30.12 mm exceeds stock tolerance, 4 pcs flagged.
Certificate missing for steel lot 7741, parts quarantined until verified.
24 pcs packed in foam trays, 6 trays per carton, labels facing up.
Carton of 40 pcs sealed with tape and weighed at 12.4 kg.
Parts wrapped in VCI paper and placed in 300x200 mm boxes.
Batch of 120 pcs counted and packed into 5 cartons of 24 pcs each.
Anti-rust oil applied to 60 pcs before boxing.
Pallet of 16 cartons stretch-wrapped and labeled with batch number.
Packing list matched with 75 pcs ordered, no discrepancies.
Each bag sealed with heat sealer at 180 °C and checked for leaks.
Dividers inserted between layers in 2 tiers per crate.
Shipping labels printed and attached to 8 crates.
Parts dried with air gun for 30 seconds before packing.
Protective caps fitted on 50 threaded bushings before boxing.
Crate lid screwed down with 12 screws torqued to standard.
3 pcs rejected at packing: surface scratched, returned to polishing.
Carton label showed wrong part number, 2 cartons relabeled before shipping.
5 pcs packed with burrs on bore edge, sent back for deburring.
1 pc with thread M10 out of gauge found during boxing, removed from batch.
Heat sealer jaw overheated at 210 °C, stopped for 15 min cooling.
Label printer jammed twice, reprinted 6 labels manually.
Strapping machine tension sensor failed, pallet banded by hand.
Conveyor belt slipped at packing station, speed reduced to 0.4 m/s.
Foam inserts arrived 5 mm thinner than specified, double-layered to compensate.
Cardboard cartons delivered with crushed corners on 4 boxes, replaced.
VCI paper roll torn at 2 m, 1.5 m usable length spliced.
Plastic bags 0.05 mm thin, split on 3 of 40 pcs, rebagged in heavier film.
